description: This Java source file defines the class CompatActionBarNavHandler, which acts as an adapter for handling action bar navigation events in an Android application. It implements the TabListener and OnNavigationListener interfaces to relay navigation events to a listener, specifically CompatActionBarNavListener. The class is designed for use on Android SDK level 11 and above, facilitating navigation event handling through tabs and navigation items.

classes.name: CompatActionBarNavHandler
classes.description: Adapter for action bar navigation events, implementing TabListener and OnNavigationListener to delegate navigation events to a specified listener.

methods.name: CompatActionBarNavHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handler with a listener to notify on navigation events.

methods.name: onTabSelected
methods.description: Called when a tab is selected; relays the event to the navigation listener.

methods.name: onNavigationItemSelected
methods.description: Called when a navigation item is selected; relays the event to the listener.

methods.name: onTabReselected
methods.description: Called when a tab is re-selected; not used in this application.

methods.name: onTabUnselected
methods.description: Called when a tab is unselected; not used in this application.
